isha_chapter3_verse1.title: Isha Chapter 3 Verse 1
isha_chapter3_verse1.introduction: This verse belongs to Isha, Chapter 3.
isha_chapter3_verse1.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Isha Upanishad, Chapter 3, Verse 1, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
isha_chapter3_verse1.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
